text: Meeting deadlines is a crucial skill in both work and study. Good time management starts with breaking a large project into smaller tasks and setting personal milestones. Prioritization helps you focus on the most important items first, so you don’t waste energy on minor details. However, projects can change unexpectedly. In that case, scope management is key: be realistic about what you can achieve and avoid adding extra tasks without adjusting your timeline. Finally, communication is essential. If you realize you’re going to be late, tell your manager or teacher early. They may offer help or extend the deadline. Being proactive shows responsibility and builds trust.
